jobs.title: AB InBev MBA Summer 2027 Intern - FINANCE/STRATEGY
jobs.description:
Dreaming big is in our DNA. It’s who we are as a company. It’s our culture. It’s our heritage. And more than ever, it’s our future. A future where we’re always looking forward. Always serving up new ways to meet life’s moments. A future where we keep dreaming bigger. We look for people with passion, talent, and curiosity, and provide them with the teammates, resources and opportunities to unleash their full potential. The power we create together – when we combine your strengths with ours – is unstoppable. Are you ready to join a team that dreams as big as you do?

Program Overview:
Dreaming Big is in our DNA. Brewing the world’s most loved beers and crafting meaningful experiences is what inspires us. We are owners, empowered to lead real change, deliver on tough challenges, and take accountability for the results. We are looking for only the most ambitious, curious, and bold people that have the potential to become senior leaders and lead future growth for our company.
Our  MBA Internship  is a 10-week summer experience designed to develop future leaders by providing hands-on experience in key business areas, with a focus on the Finance and Strategy  functions. You will gain industry exposure, be integrated into our business, work on high-impact projects, and tackle real-world challenges building on your previous professional and academic experiences.

What You’ll Do:
- Own and execute a strategic project that addresses a key business challenge
- Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the organization
- Conduct market research, data analysis, and modeling to support decision-making
- Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership
- Engage in networking, mentorship, and professional development opportunities

Who You Are:
- First year MBA candidate currently enrolled in a full-time business school program
- 3-10 years operational experience in Finance, Strategy or a related function
- Embody our culture of ownership – You Own it, Dream Big, and Make it Happen
- A strategic thinker with strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- A self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset and a passion for the beverage industry
- Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills demonstrated in previous work and extracurricular activities
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
- Must be authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis, without the need for sponsorship now or in the future.

Salary:  $5K sign on bonus + $5k bi-weekly
Start Date:  June 7 th, 2027

OUR EMPLOYEE VALUE PROPOSITION

OUR 10 PRINCIPLES:
We are Owners who…
- Dream big
- Focus on superior results
- Lead by example and take accountability
- Attract and develop great people
- Build brands consumers love
- Grow with customers and communities
- Prioritize simple and scalable solutions
- Manage costs tightly
- Think long-term
- Never take shortcuts

WHAT WE OFFER:
- UNIQUE CULTURE - We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and
- are passionate about building upon our company’s long legacy.
- We believe in collaboration and candor, and that means a dynamic and informal workplace. We respectfully speak openly, give constructive, direct feedback and challenge each other to remain focused on our goals.

- BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES - We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites.
- We love that our friends and family enjoy our products just as much as we do. That’s just one reason we keep our consumers at the heart of everything we do. Another reason? We take pride in contributing to the world's most renowned events, festivals and meaningful moments that contribute to growth, positive impact and a future with more cheers.

- GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES - As a global company with operations in nearly 50 countries, we expose our people to unique opportunities, we empower them to learn, expand their perspectives and unlock career growth.
- In an environment where commitment to excellence pays off, our people are able to deepen their impact and create a long- lasting legacy. Our people grow at the pace of their talent and their results.

WHAT WE ASK OF OUR PEOPLE:
- OWN IT - Ownership is at the foundation of everything we do.
- We look for owners who are empowered to lead positive change and take accountability for their results. When we come together, we don’t let our titles define us; we push each other to find the best solutions for our business strategy.

- DREAM BIG - We dream big because we believe that through collective focus, discipline and the strength of our teams, we can achieve anything. We empower our owners to push the boundaries of what’s possible to deliver on our strategy and purpose.
- We look for people with passion, curiosity, and ambition to make a difference and grow with our business.

- MAKE IT HAPPEN - We know that our actions matter more then words. We walk the talk. For us, there is no such thing as “this is not my problem.”
- We value resilience and commitment to excellence when facing challenges. We look for people who know how to transform big dreams into measurable results and shared success, through hard-work, consistency and long-term thinking.

jobs.title: Trade Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Dreaming big is in our DNA. It’s who we are as a company. It’s our culture. It’s our heritage. And more than ever, it’s our future. A future where we’re always looking forward. Always serving up new ways to meet life’s moments. A future where we keep dreaming bigger. We look for people with passion, talent, and curiosity, and provide them with the teammates, resources and opportunities to unleash their full potential. The power we create together – when we combine your strengths with ours – is unstoppable. Are you ready to join a team that dreams as big as you do?

SALARY: $106,400 - $126,350, bonus and long-term incentive eligible

COMPANY:
We are home to the nation’s most iconic beer and beyond beer brands, including Michelob ULTRA – America’s #1 top-selling beer – as well as Busch Light, Budweiser, Bud Light, Stella Artois, Cutwater Spirits, and industry-leading craft brands. From our longstanding efforts to support American farmers, military, veterans, and first responders, to emergency drinking water donations and responsible drinking programs, we are guided by our commitment to the communities we call home and the 65,000 hardworking Americans who bring our beer to life. We are powered by a team that shares our passion to create a future with more cheers. Are you ready to join a team that dreams as big as you do?

ROLE SUMMARY:
The Trade Marketing Manager is responsible for bringing the AB portfolio to life across wholesalers, retailers, venues, and events. The role combines trade marketing, activation, sponsorships, and execution leadership. It requires strong organization, creativity, communication skills, and flexibility to support nights and weekends for events and activation.

JOB RESPONSIBILTIES:
- Lead On-Premise strategy and local execution of plans.

- Own On-Premise channel performance and identify execution opportunities with wholesalers.

- Drive: Brand planning / Sampling execution / Event and venue activations

- Own local sponsorship negotiations and activation budgets.

- Manage mobile asset deployment and support venue CAPEX execution.

- Partner closely with top wholesalers to ensure execution against plans.

- Own execution KPIs for On-Premise plans.

- Lead implementation of brand programming in Off-Premise channels to drive volume and share growth.

- Communicate priorities and results weekly and monthly.

- Cascade annual and trimester plans, initiatives, and programs.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:
- Demonstrated ability to build relationships and maintain effective working relationships with distributors, top level account decision makers, and all internal stakeholders

- Must reside in Houston, Texas

- High level of company products and beer industry knowledge

- Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with employees, customers, and third-party partners

- Highly self-motivated and results oriented with ability to work independently

- Excellent communication skills: oral, written, and comfortable with presenting to groups

- Strong organizational & planning skills

- Demonstrated knowledge of Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

- Effective time management in planning daily routines, wholesaler visits, and event activations

- Willingness to be flexible with schedule based on needs of business

- Bachelor's Degree required; MBA Preferred

- 5-7 years of sales and/or marketing experience, preferably in the beverage or consumer products industry

- Thorough knowledge of AB sales and marketing strategies and procedures

- Must possess a valid driver’s license

WHY ANHEUSER-BUSCH:
At Anheuser-Busch, our purpose is to create a future with more cheers. For more than 165 years as a leading American manufacturer, Anheuser-Busch has delivered a legacy of brewing great-tasting, high-quality beers that have satisfied beer drinkers for generations. As the nation’s top brewer, one of the fastest growing spirits companies, and an insurgent force in energy drinks, we drive economic prosperity nationwide through investments in our people, facilities, and communities. We are the only alcohol company that invests in the U.S. at this scale .

BENEFITS:

- Health benefits including Medical, Dental, Vision, Wellness and Tax-Advantaged Savings and Spending Accounts

- Life Insurance and Disability Income Protection

- Generous Parental Leave and FMLA policies

- 401(k) Retirement Savings options with a company matching contribution

- Chance to work in a fast-paced environment among a company of owners

- Free Beer!

ROLE SUMMARY:
The Benefits Manager, Health and Welfare plays an important role in supporting Anheuser-Busch’s U.S. benefits programs for employees and their families. This role helps deliver meaningful, well-managed benefit programs while improving the employee experience.
This is a great opportunity for a benefits professional who enjoys solving problems, working with data, partnering across teams, and making complex benefit programs easier for employees to understand and use.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Manage the day-to-day administration of U.S. health and welfare benefits, including coordination with internal teams, vendors, carriers, and third-party administrators.
- Support benefit strategy by reviewing enrollment, claims, vendor performance, employee feedback, market trends, and program costs.
- Create clear, employee-friendly communications that help employees understand and use their benefits.
- Assist with benefit financial management, including budgeting, forecasting, invoice review, reconciliation, and cost analysis.
- Maintain compliant plan documentation and support benefit-related audits, filings, controls, and data validation activities.
- Identify opportunities to simplify processes, strengthen program administration, improve self-service, and enhance the overall benefits experience.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS:
- Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
- 5+ years of experience in employee benefits, health and welfare plan administration, Total Rewards, HR operations, or vendor management.
- Experience supporting health and welfare benefit programs, preferably in a large, self-funded, multi-state, multi-vendor, or union environment.
- Working knowledge of benefits administration, eligibility rules, annual enrollment, employee communications, plan documentation, and core compliance requirements.
- Ability to analyze benefits data, identify trends, evaluate financial impacts, and explain findings in a clear, practical way.
- Strong project management, communication, organization, stakeholder partnership, discretion, and confidentiality skills.

- Life Insurance and Disability Income Protection
- Generous Parental Leave and FMLA policies
